summary: 3D Black Sea fishing and boat-management game, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Karadeniz'de 3D balıkçılık ve tekne yönetimi oyunu, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: A boat that handles like one: slow engine, a rudder that bites only when moving, waves and wind
Schools of boids on the sonar; circle a purse-seine net around them and haul
Four species with different speed, nerve and price; deeper fish escape under the net
Fog, forecast storms, a fish market with seasonal prices and upgrades for net, sonar, engine, hold, ice box and crew
The ?auto bot finished the 30-day season as reis with the loan paid on day 26-27; one index.html, everything generated in code

social.headline: Net the schools, beat the storm and pay off the boat in 30 days · Sürüleri ağla, fırtınayı atlat, tekne kredisini 30 günde öde
